title: Labels and the table
subtitle: Reading the Dão and eating with it

steps.title: Reading the label
steps.body: Labels show Dão DOC, sometimes Dão Nobre, a top category requiring higher quality and ageing, the producer, often a quinta, the grapes and Reserva or Garrafeira. Red Dão must include at least 20% Touriga Nacional. Many wines are blends with grapes listed on the back.

steps.title: At the table
steps.body: Dão reds suit roast kid, lamb, game, Portuguese rice dishes like arroz de pato, duck rice, and Serra da Estrela cheese, a creamy sheep's cheese from the nearby mountains. Encruzado suits bacalhau, grilled fish, roast chicken and creamy dishes. Serve reds at 16 to 17, whites at 10 to 12.

steps.prompt: Which cheese, from nearby mountains, suits Dão wines?
steps.explanation: A creamy sheep's cheese from Portugal's highest mountains.

steps.body: Dão reds age gracefully. A 10-year-old Dão Reserva often shows red fruit, pine and leather in perfect balance.

steps.prompt: Dão reds must include at least 20% Touriga Nacional.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Labels show DOC, Dão Nobre and Reserva
Dão reds suit kid, lamb and Serra da Estrela cheese
Encruzado suits bacalhau and creamy dishes
